units.source_text: ……连这位哲学家的名字，我都忘了，

en.t: ...I have even forgotten the name of this philosopher,

units.source_text: 在这段话之后，他还说了些什么，我不知道。

en.t: and I do not know what else he said after these words.
I remember only this one sentence.

units.source_text: 所谓植物，是仅指花开叶落，

en.t: Whether the word plants refers only to flowers blooming and leaves falling,

units.source_text: 还是有更深的内涵，我也不知道。

en.t: or whether it holds some deeper meaning, I do not know either.

units.source_text: 此时此刻，我感到佛教的各种经文是无与伦比的可贵的抒情诗。

en.t: At this very moment, I feel that the various Buddhist scriptures are precious lyric poems beyond compare.

units.source_text: 这样，即使我想对已故的你说话，

en.t: So even if I want to speak to you, who are dead,

units.source_text: 而你已属于那个世界，尽管你的形象依然和在阳世时一样。

en.t: you already belong to that other world, though your image remains just as it was in this one.

units.source_text: 我不如面对眼前壁龛里的早开的红梅——

en.t: I would rather turn toward the early-blooming red plum in the alcove before me—

units.source_text: 我假设你已转世为红梅——诉说衷情。

en.t: imagining that you have been reborn as that red plum—and speak the feelings in my heart.

units.source_text: 这不知该叫人多高兴啊。

en.t: How happy such a thought can make one.

units.source_text: 哪怕不是眼前的名花那又何妨呢。

en.t: And what does it matter if it is not the famous flower before my eyes?

units.source_text: 我想象你转世成未曾见过的花，

en.t: I imagine you reborn as flowers I have never seen,

units.source_text: 这些花生长在像法国那样遥远的国度一座不知名的山上。

en.t: flowers growing on an unknown mountain in a country as far away as France.

units.source_text: 就是面对这样的花说话也是一样。

en.t: It would be the same even to speak to flowers like those.

units.source_text: 可见我依然爱你，并且爱得如此深沉。

en.t: This shows that I still love you, and that I love you so deeply.
